description:
Configure Skills-Based Routing for the 'AGENTDIRECT' Inbound Group. 

1. Modify the 'AGENTDIRECT' Inbound Group settings so that the 'Next Agent Call' routing method is set to 'rank'.
2. Modify User '6666' to assign them a specific Rank of '9' for the 'AGENTDIRECT' group (under 'Allowed Inbound Groups').

Starting state: Logged into Vicidial Admin. The group and user exist but are not configured for ranking.
